summary: Currenc Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K to disclose an amendment to a loan agreement and promissory note between its wholly-owned subsidiary Seamless Group Inc., lender Moca Services Limited, guarantor Alexander King Ong Kong, and Pine Mountain Holdings Limited. The amendment extends the maturity date of the loan and promissory note from three months to fifteen months after closing, with conforming changes to proceeds uses, collateral adjustments, assignment consent, and Nasdaq deficiency cure provisions. The loan is secured by a share mortgage over 1,000,000 ordinary shares of Currenc held by Pine Mountain, transferred to Moca Services at closing and to be returned upon repayment. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation.
